title: osie remote status NAME --json
description: Both requests travel over one SSH connection. Each `body` is the agent's response embedded verbatim (validated JSON, never re-serialised): api_ready, and api_capabilities or an api_error envelope (403 for a health-tier user). Exit status 0 if readiness answered 2xx, 1 otherwise; transport failures use remote_error.

ssh_connect_ms.description: ssh spawned until the forwarding socket existed
